excerpt.zh: 我们已经用勘探器遗珍的强力扫描光束扫描了我们的领土，并且在[chosen_planet.GetName]上发现了一个以前不为人知的资源储藏！
excerpt.en: We have swept our space with the strong scanning beam of the Surveyor relic, and a previously unknown resource deposit has been identified on [chosen_planet.GetName]!
